metadata.scope: deterministic state probes over the learner store + planner (no LLM, no network, no randomness); LLM-utterance consistency is the named v1 extension point
metadata.novelty: first-in-domain: memory-consistency probing applied to a tutor's learner-model + planner (not LLM-judged dialogue)
metadata.session_boundary: SQLite close + reopen on the same db per probe

P1.description: struggled-fact persistence: a silent-e substitution struggle planted in session 1 keeps the silent-e-gated successor LOCKED in session 2 (mastery gate passes, class gate fires)
P1.evidence: silent_e mastery=0.9042 >= 0.8 (mastery gate PASS); last-5 substitution blockers=1 (class gate FIRES); vowel_team_ai_ay unlocked=False; planner served='cvc_short_a'

P2.description: mastery continuity: every session-1 mastery value reappears bit-exact in session 2 (no drift on reopen)
P2.evidence: all 2 session-1 mastery values reappear bit-exact in session 2 (max |delta| < 1e-12): cvc_short_a=0.743789, cvc_short_i_u=0.983261

P3.description: due-review consistency: a skill failed in session 1 is due for review BEFORE a skill passed in session 1
P3.evidence: cvc_short_e_o (failed S1) due=2026-06-10T09:20:00+00:00 < sight_words_1 (passed S1) due=2026-06-12T09:00:02+00:00

P4.description: completed-skill memory: a skill completed (>=0.95) in session 1 is never served as 'new' in session 2 (served-log + planner agree)
P4.evidence: cvc_short_a mastery=0.9833 >= 0.95; served as 'new' in S1 log=True; S2 re-serves as 'new'=0 (planner+served-log agree it stays completed)

P5.description: cross-skill inference guard: struggles planted only on skill A do not alter skill B's mastery or B's gating (memory is skill-scoped)
P5.evidence: failures planted only on cvc_short_a; cvc_short_e_o mastery 0.946205 -> 0.946205 (unchanged=True); cvc_short_e_o unlocked True -> True (unchanged=True)

P6.description: over-personalization guard: one generic (untagged) failure on a mastered root skill keeps it >= threshold (servable) and unlock status unchanged
P6.evidence: one generic failure on cvc_short_a: mastery=0.9042 >= floor 0.8 (True); own unlock status True (unchanged=True); completed-status retained=False

findings: [P6] OVER-PERSONALIZATION SENSITIVITY: one generic (untagged) failure on cvc_short_a dropped mastery to 0.9042, BELOW MASTERY_COMPLETED (0.95) — the skill loses 'completed' status from a single data point. It stays >= 0.8 (servable/unlocked), so the promised invariant holds, but one bad observation un-completes a mastered skill. Mitigation belongs in the completion hysteresis (require N consecutive sub-threshold obs before un-completing), tracked as a v1 planner item.
